intent: Complete an itemised current-tree Phase 1 reconnaissance with linked finding and atomic coverage ledgers before setting structural targets.

reasons.evidence: Dependency and hosted-state queries read external services; this batch writes only reproducible evidence, tests and task records.

invariants: Preserve the identities and source references of all 265 preliminary findings, 163 split operator dispositions and 107 original coverage bullets; the T-0159 ledger remains historical input.
Decompose compound bullets into independently evidenced obligations. A source line, old sceptic verdict or empty SQLite column alone never establishes a current-tree outcome.

Every item carries source, inspected revision, reproducible method, current disposition, independent sceptic verdict, ruling, owner and explicit uncertainty. Deferred or unresolved items name their missing proof.
Classify current bindingless catches and source-reading candidate suites without treating candidates as confirmed assertions or converting the classify-only ruling into removal work.
Secret scanning is redacted and records scanner version, configuration, exact ref scope and gaps. A green hosted Gitleaks job with an unproved configuration is not a clearance verdict.
Use isolated fixtures and data for build, SQLite, browser, bundle and CSP probes. Preserve authorised visual behaviour and separate source, running-app, host and operator evidence.
Freeze tooling, docs and org scope definitions and baselines. Report protected, historical and generated material separately; do not create a reduction incentive to rewrite them.

Independent sceptics challenge each dimension; a final completeness critic checks every ledger row. No feature is removed and no protected, derived, append-only or historical task file is hand-edited.
rollback: Revert the new reconnaissance records, inventories and oracle as one documentation batch; keep T-0159 and all accepted rulings unchanged.

The unchanged-tree full gate, committed-tree sweep and every hosted job pass.
